get.description: Liveness check that also touches the database. Needs no identity.
The people (not Admin), for assigning and the admin pages.
Every location, ordered by parent, then position; the client builds the tree.

post.description: Adds a location as the last of its siblings.

patch.description:
Renames a location, changes its icon, moves it among its siblings or under
another location (what's inside it going along).

delete.description:
Deletes a location and its stock rows; refuses while it has child locations. An item
kept nowhere else stops being restocked.
Deletes an item and its stock rows in every location.

get.description: Every stock row in the house; small enough to send whole.

put.description: Sets an item's level in a location, adding the item there if it isn't kept there yet.

delete.description:
Stops keeping an item in a location, cancelling its request to buy it there. Taken
off its last place, it stops being restocked. Where any variant will do, the others
kept there may now all be short.

post.description:
Puts an item kept here on the shopping list by hand, whatever its level: for what
isn't kept stocked, bought now and then. If it's already on, returns that (200).

Moves items from one place to another, as when they get put away elsewhere: the
level goes along, and so does a request to buy one there, claim and all. Where the
other place keeps the item already, the two merge, the fuller level kept. All or
nothing. The moved rows, as they end up.

get.description: Every group and subgroup, ordered by parent, then position; the client nests them.

post.description:
Adds a group (with a colour) or a subgroup (wearing its group's), last of its
siblings.

patch.description:
Renames a group, changes its colour, icons or shelf life, moves it among its
siblings, or moves a subgroup to another group. A group stays a group and a subgroup a
subgroup. Fresh food planned for a cooking is dated again.

delete.description:
Deletes a subgroup, its items moving up to its group; a group only once it has no
subgroups and no items.

post.description:
Adds a lasting chore to a place (or the house), or a one-off to-do, which is
reported at once.

delete.description: Deletes a chore and its requests.

post.description: Reports that a chore needs doing; if it's already reported, returns that request (200).

Records a chore as done just now: its open or claimed request if it has one (and
tells the other), else a request that's done from the start (nobody needs telling).
`by`: the person who did it, when marked for them.

get.description: The open and claimed requests, oldest first, scheduled chores that fell due included.

post.description:
Writes something on the shopping list that isn't kept track of: no item, no place.
Done or cancelled, it's gone like any request; the same name may be on it twice.
Says "I'm on it". Only an open request can be claimed.

Gives a request to someone (the admin pages): claimed for them, whether it was open
or someone's already; they're told. They can hand it back like their own claim.
Takes back one's own claim, opening the request again.

Marks a request done, whoever claimed it; a bought item's level goes back to plenty
(one written in by hand has none, nor one bought for a cooking that's kept nowhere).
Where any variant will do, `item_id` says which was bought: that one goes to plenty in
the place, kept there from now on if it wasn't. An item with no place (a written line
taken into the inventory) is put in `location_id` as it's bought, kept there from now on.
`by`: the person who bought it, when marked for them.

Takes something written on the shopping list into the inventory: the line becomes
one of an item (one of the same name and variant, or a new one) with no place yet,
claimed as it was; done asks where it goes. Where that item is already on the list
with no place, the written line just goes. 409 if the line was dealt with meanwhile.

Asks whoever claimed a request when it'll be done: a push to their devices. Only
someone else's claim, and once a (local) day; 409 otherwise.
Drops a request that's no longer needed; a buy request leaves the level as it is.

get.description: The server's public key, for subscribing a device.

put.description: Sends this user's notifications to a device; sending one again refreshes it.

delete.description: Stops notifications to a device (given by its endpoint); unknown ones are fine.

get.description: Every device that gets notifications, by user, last seen first (admin pages).

delete.description: Stops notifications to a device, say an old phone (admin pages).

get.description: Server-Sent Events: `{"by": <user id or null>}` whenever the house changes.

post.description: Adds a recipe; ingredients the catalogue doesn't have yet are added to it.

patch.description: Changes the fields sent; `ingredients` replaces the whole list.

delete.description: Deletes a recipe; its planned cookings go with it, and the lines only they needed.

get.description: The cookings not cooked yet, earliest first; past days' too.

post.description: Plans a recipe for a day: what it needs and the house lacks goes on the list.

patch.description:
Moves a cooking to another day, changes its side dish or who cooks it. Its lines
follow: the earliest cooking lacking an item is the one its line is due for.

delete.description:
Cancels a planned cooking: the lines only it needed go, unless someone's buying them
already (they're told, with the other).

post.description:
Marks a cooking cooked, with what's left: the levels sent are set (the list follows,
as on a place's page). Lines still waiting for it go, unless someone's buying them.

get.description: The latest entries, newest first; older than `before_id` for the next page.

post.description: Logs this browser in as Admin, by a long-lived cookie. Only on the admin port.
Ends this browser's Admin session.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: What someone did, as the activity log records it.

Hue.title: Hue
Hue.description: A group's tile colour, from the web client's fixed palette (one per icon colour).

IngredientIn.title: IngredientIn
IngredientIn.description:
An ingredient by name: the catalogue item of this name and variant, made (kept
nowhere) if there's none. `any_variant`: any variant of the name will do, the variant
is left out. `recipe`: the name is a recipe's, taken whole (a part, "Nokedli"); it has
no variant.

IngredientOut.title: IngredientOut
IngredientOut.description: An item (`item_id`) or another recipe (`part_id`), never both.

ItemRef.title: ItemRef
ItemRef.description: An item by name and variant; made (kept nowhere) if the catalogue hasn't one.

LevelLeft.title: LevelLeft
LevelLeft.description: What's left of an item in a place after cooking.

PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn
PushSubscriptionIn.description: A browser's PushSubscription, as its toJSON() gives it.

PushSubscriptionOut.title: PushSubscriptionOut
PushSubscriptionOut.description: A device that gets notifications, for the admin pages.

RecipeKind.title: RecipeKind
RecipeKind.description: What a recipe is on the table: what goes with it when it's planned.

RequestAssign.title: RequestAssign
RequestAssign.description: Whom to give a request to: claimed for them.

RequestCreate.title: RequestCreate
RequestCreate.description: Something to buy that isn't kept track of, written on the shopping list.

RequestKeep.title: RequestKeep
RequestKeep.description:
Something written on the shopping list, kept track of from now on: as this item (an
existing one of the same name and variant, or a new one), its place chosen once bought.

StockMove.title: StockMove
StockMove.description: Items kept in one place, to be kept in another instead.
